findings.evidence: Handler line: `if (!req.body || !req.body.reason) { return res.status(400).json(errorResponse("missing_reason", "reason is required")); }` — the handler rejects any request whose body omits `reason`, but the specification marks `reason` as `required: false`, so a valid request per the spec is rejected with 400. (verified: {"success":false,"code":"missing_reason","message":"reason is required"})
